{{Quote|Dark forces linger around this old sarcophagus&hellip;|Master [[Arca Jeth]]|audio=ArcaDarkForces-TotJ.flac|<ref name="Tales of the Jedi (audio)">[[Tales of the Jedi (audio drama)|''Tales of the Jedi'' audio drama]]</ref>}}
Within the [[tomb of Freedon Nadd]] was '''a sarcophagus''' that contained the physical remains of [[Freedon Nadd]], [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]]. The sarcophagus also contained [[Freedon Nadd's short lightsaber]], which could have been taken from it by companions of [[Meetra Surik]].
